query: For my 86‑year‑old female inpatient, among women 81–91, what is the 25th percentile duration (days) of dihydropyridine CCB prescriptions?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY duration) AS percentile_duration FROM dihydropyridine_ccb;
